newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium sold 6.789 bln Bfr worth of state notes.
newsitem.headline: Belgium sold 6.789 bln Bfr worth of state notes.

text.p: The Belgian finance ministry said on Tuesday an issue of state notes had raised a total 6.789 billion Belgian francs by the end of the fourth subscription day.
The ministry said in a statement that altogether it had sold 4.809 billion francs of five year notes, extendable to seven years. The notes carry a fixed coupon of 4.70 percent.
Notes with revisable coupons and put options after three, five and seven years raised 1.979 billion francs, the finance ministry said. Subscriptions close today.
